scope: Six genuine upstream production changes at six declared historical bases, three new repositories, Python and Node. Retrospective contract case studies, no inference.
limitations: Small nonrandom retrospective sample, upstream fixes read before assertions; no blindness or general accuracy claim.
Two flattening performance revisions share one public contract; performance itself is not evaluated.
Exact finite JSON function calls exclude filesystem/browser/database/distributed behavior and multiple valid encodings.
Accepted upstream reference overlaps candidate; authored alternatives are not genuine candidate submissions or separate human reviews.
Selected unchanged baseline files exclude newly added upstream tests, packaging, lint, and other suites.
No new AI model execution or costs; upstream developer authorship only.

assessment.root_cause: Whole-input lowercasing destroys existing internal capitals.
assessment.explanation: Reproduced historical regression in authentic accepted upstream f79de04e. Base README explicitly says camelcase(FooBarBaz) returns fooBarBaz; actual output is foobarbaz. The unchanged test independently fails on FooBar -> foobar (12 passed / 1 failed). Both formal trials reproduce it. Authored alternate preserves capitals and joins reported spaced words; all assertions and baseline tests pass. This is a candidate/reference behavior disagreement, not a check error, and zero additional independent detection because ordinary checks already fail. No new upstream discovery claimed.
